title: Add cost-epoch sparklines and observability gatekeeper
author: Marina Lopez
description: Summary: Introduces a compact, epoch-oriented cost sparkline and an 'Observability Gatekeeper' policy that reduces alert noise by gating SLO alerts based on cohort signal strength. Motivation: We continue to see alert churn from small/noisy cohorts where token-level variance triggers runbooks for investigations with low ROI. Two orthogonal features help: 1) Cost-epoch sparklines provide a compact, per-invocation historical mini-graph (epoch windows) for quick triage directly in the invocation UI and dashboard. 2) Observability Gatekeeper enforces simple signal thresholds before firing SLO/Cost alerts (cohort size, cumulative tokens, or stable rank). Design: - Metrics: add invocation_epoch_cost (histogram per-epoch), epoch_cost_sparkline (pre-aggregated 10/60/3600s rollups), epoch_cohort_size gauge. - Tracing: add span.tag epoch_id and span.annotation {epoch.window_ms, epoch.bucket_idx} to make rollups joinable to traces without full KV hydration. - Logs: introduce compact log-rollup keys (epoch_rollup_id) and a retention hint to keep only high-entropy rollups beyond short retention. - Gatekeeper: a pluggable policy module that evaluates cohort purity and token volume before turning an alert into an incident. Policies are expressible as JSON rules and evaluated in the alerting pipeline stage; default is conservative (cohort_size >= 50 OR tokens_last_5m >= 10000 OR historical_percentile_delta > 0.2). Rollout plan: feature-flagged; enable for internal orgs -> canary on staging -> 25% of traffic in prod -> global. Observability changes are additive and behind flags. Checklist: - [x] Metric registration and unit tests - [x] Span tag wiring + integration test - [x] Console panel + small Grafana dashboard JSON - [x] Gatekeeper policy + unit tests - [x] Documentation draft under docs/observability - [x] E2E canary + CI green Further notes: This PR focuses on instrumentation and the policy engine; automatic remediation is intentionally out-of-scope and will be a follow-up. Backfills: minimal; the rollup table will be populated from the streaming aggregator over the next 48 hours post-merge.
